wiki_text: Marsa LNG is a 1 million-tonne-per-annum LNG liquefaction plant under construction at the Port of Sohar in northern Oman, developed by Marsa LNG LLC, a joint venture of TotalEnergies (80%) and OQ Exploration & Production (OQEP, 20%). The partners reached a final investment decision in 2024 and broke ground on 1 May 2025, with production targeted to start in the first quarter of 2028. The plant's output is primarily intended for marine fuel (LNG bunkering) in the Gulf, with a dedicated bunkering vessel, the Monte Shams, under construction for deployment at Sohar from 2028. Marketed as one of the lowest carbon-intensity LNG facilities in the world, the plant is fully electrified and paired with a 300 MWp solar farm sized to cover its annual energy needs. It is a distinct facility from the existing Oman LNG complex at Qalhat (Sur).
